dct_creator_sm: Everard, Kelsey (New York University, University of British Columbia). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1390-2463
dct_description_sm: The data included here are useful in the application of the Ellipse Approximation method, which allows for the estimation of sweeping and advection velocities. This dataset is a collection of case studies selected from two weeks of data collected during a field campaign investigating turbulent exchange within and above a sloped vineyard in the Okanagan Valley, British Columbia. These case studies were selected because the predominate wind direction at all five measurement heights was aligned in the upslope direction (parallel to the vineyard rows; towards the east), and all of the deployed instruments were working properly.
dct_title_s: Replication Data for: Sweeping Effects Modify Taylor’s Frozen Turbulence Hypothesis for Scalars in the Roughness Sublayer
